name: all-mail
description: all-Mail v2 source-available Docker-first Go email control plane

scripts.install:all: ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh npm --prefix web install && ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh npm --prefix cloudflare/workers/allmail-edge install
scripts.test: ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh npm --prefix web run test
scripts.check:go: cd core && test -z "$(gofmt -l .)" && go test -race ./... && go vet ./... && output="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/allmail-release-check-$$" && go build -trimpath -o "$output" ./cmd/allmail && rm -f "$output"
scripts.verify:release: ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh npm run check:go && ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh npm --prefix web run lint && ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh npm --prefix web run test && ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh npm --prefix web run build && ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh npm --prefix cloudflare/workers/allmail-edge run check && ./scripts/sanitize-runtime-env.sh npm run audit:prod
